title: HelperSessionSpawnSSHResult
description: Result of the helper session service's spawn-ssh op: the new session's inventory entry (nocx-50w7p.4). It is the SAME shape `spawn` and `sessions` return — a session is a session, and a caller that spawned one and a caller that found one must hold the same value — with the union's `ssh` branch carrying the destination and no pid, no pgid and no resolved cwd, because this machine has none of those facts about a process that lives on another one. The inventory's `observed` is null for such a session: evidence about pids is evidence about THIS machine's kernel, and nobody here can be asked about a remote shell.
